mapper.sql: c.category_id, c.bbs_master_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.sort_order, c.use_yn, c.delete_yn, c.created_by, c.created_ip, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_ip, c.updated_at, m.bbs_code AS bbs_code, m.bbs_name AS bbs_name, m.site_id AS site_id, s.site_code AS site_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bbs_category c JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = c.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE c.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.category_name ASC

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_bbs_article a WHERE a.category_id = c.category_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS article_count FROM tb_bbs_category c JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = c.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE c.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.category_name ASC
SELECT FROM tb_bbs_category c JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = c.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_category ( category_id, bbs_master_id, category_code, category_name, sort_order, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{bbsMasterId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_category SET category_code=#{categoryCode}, category_name=#{categoryName}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, use_yn=#{useYn}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_category SET use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_category SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_bbs_category WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
